name: lemeng.retail_order_line.page.v2
_note: retail_order_line 的 **v2 单页子管线**（draft，由 lemeng.retail_order_line.foreach.v2 的 ctl.foreach 驱动）。
子管线内**零 ${ENV:...}**：branch_nums / system_book / bizday / bucket / region / sink_root / run_token
全部由父管线以 ITER_ITEM_* 列显式传入（ctl.foreach 不展开 ENV，2026-09-28 实测）。
每页落 chunk=<page>.parquet（同一 bizday 分区多文件），失败只影响该页；页收据写 /workspace/logs/retail-v2-foreach/。

data.label: UNNEST pos_order_details + 定型到契约列

properties.sql:
SELECT
  '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}' AS batch_id,
  '${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST(strptime(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_bizday'), '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) AS bizday,
  CAST(date_part('hour', CAST(o.order_time AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS hour,
  CAST(o.order_no AS VARCHAR) AS order_no,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_num') AS VARCHAR) AS order_detail_num,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.branch_num') AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
  json_extract_string(CAST(o.branch AS JSON), '$.branch_name') AS branch_name,
  CAST(o.order_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_time,
  CAST(o.order_operate_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_operate_time,
  CAST(o.state AS VARCHAR) AS state,
  CAST(o.order_source AS VARCHAR) AS order_source,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.item_num') AS VARCHAR) AS item_num,
  json_extract_string(u.d, '$.item_code') AS item_code,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_money') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS sale_money,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_discount') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS discount_money,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_payment_money') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS payment_money,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_amount') AS DECIMAL(14,3)) AS quantity,
  CAST(o.order_transaction_type AS VARCHAR) AS order_transaction_type,
  CAST(o.order_ref_billno AS VARCHAR) AS order_ref_billno,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_share_discount') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS order_detail_share_discount,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_std_price') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS order_detail_std_price,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_price') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS order_detail_price,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_online_qty') AS DECIMAL(14,3)) AS order_detail_online_qty,
  CAST(o.order_total_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS order_total_money
FROM input o
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(from_json(CAST(o.pos_order_details AS JSON), '["JSON"]')) AS u(d)

data.label: 本页收据（父管线汇总输入）

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST('${ITER_ITEM_RUN_TOKEN}' AS VARCHAR) AS run_token,
  CAST(${ITER_ITEM_PAGE_NO} AS INTEGER) AS page_no,
  CAST(${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO} AS INTEGER) AS chunk_no,
  CAST(${ITER_ITEM_EXPECTED_PAGES} AS INTEGER) AS expected_pages,
  CAST(count(*) AS BIGINT) AS detail_rows,
  CAST(count(DISTINCT order_no) AS BIGINT) AS orders,
  'ok' AS status
FROM input
